# Storeganise

Storeganise provides modern, cloud-based management software for valet and self-storage businesses, offering features like contactless online bookings, automated billing, and comprehensive APIs for integrations.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/storeganise/.

## Actions

- **Get Admin Site by ID or Code**: Retrieve a specific site by id or code.
- **Get Admin User By ID or Email**: Retrieve a specific admin user by id or email.
- **Get Admin Users By IDs**: Fetch multiple admin users by their ids.
